{{recipesummary|category=Breakfast recipes|servings=12|time=25–30 minutes|difficulty=2|image=[[File:Banana-Nut-Muffins-2005-Aug-24.jpg|300px]]|energy=206 calories (1 muffin)
}}{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Bread|Bread]] | [[Cookbook:Breakfast|Breakfast]]

A muffin with a [[Cookbook:Cake|cake]] texture and wonderful banana taste.

==Ingredients==
* 1 ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (250 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / 8.8 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Flour|all-purpose flour]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (110 g / 3.9 oz) [[Cookbook:Sugar|granulated sugar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (40 g / 1.4 oz) [[Cookbook:Chocolate chips|semisweet chocolate chips]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (60 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] / 2 fl oz) [[Cookbook:Oil|cooking oil]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (60 ml / 2 oz) [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (250 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / 8.8 oz / 3 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]].) mashed ripe [[Cookbook:Banana|bananas]]

==Procedure==
#Measure flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, and chocolate chips into a [[Cookbook:Mixing Bowl|mixing bowl]]. Make a well in the center.
#Beat egg in a small [[Cookbook:Mixing Bowl|mixing bowl]] until frothy. Mix in cooking oil, milk, and banana.
#Pour into well in flour mixture. Stir just to moisten—the batter will be lumpy.
#Fill greased [[Cookbook:Muffin Pan|muffin cups]] ¾ full. Bake at [[Cookbook:Oven temperatures|400 °F]] (205 °C) for 15 to 20 minutes.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
*These muffins taste best when still warm.
